correctness.rationale: For target j, its complement is a path from j+1 to j-1. The event J=j is exactly visiting both endpoint neighbors before hitting j; condition on the first neighbor reached, then apply resistance-linear gambler’s ruin to reach the other neighbor before j. This establishes the two-term law with the correct denominator T_j+r_j or T_j+r_(j-1). For target i+1 and start i the formula reduces to q_i=r_i/(R-r_(i+1)); cyclic recurrence rho_i=q_i(1-rho_(i+1)) and Q=prod q_i<1 prove the signed-product inverse and uniqueness. Positivity and sum one are sufficient for realizability; subtract recurrences to prove sup-norm stability. Uniform q forces uniform rho. All n≥3, including triangle, and strictly positive boundary cases are covered. Independently constructed exact rational absorbing hitting-system calculations matched 204 instances, corroborative rather than a universal proof.
